plain_description.what: No calls. Using 70 known near-duplicate pairs between held-out and training questions, the test compared two ways to find them: searching only within the same tree leaf, and a plain similarity threshold over all questions. k-means was measured alongside.
plain_description.why: It asks whether the tree can safely serve as a shortcut for finding near-duplicate questions, i.e. for contamination checks.
plain_description.information: If searching within leaves missed more than 10% of duplicates, the advice would be to use plain similarity search. Result: undetermined. Searching within leaves missed 5 of 70 (7%), but the uncertainty range reaches about 13% and the estimate sits close to the 10% bar. So the tree is not shown to be a safe index. Paraphrases and decontamination verdicts are not covered.
